subject: English
release_scope: RPH only, Units 9–12; independent activities; Activity Book references and dated RPT pending

content_standards.1.1: Respond suitably to spoken input for different purposes.
content_standards.1.2: Develop pronunciation, stress, rhythm and intonation through listening.
content_standards.1.4: Understand and respond to spoken stories, visual material and songs or rhymes.
content_standards.2.1: Recognise, remember and comprehend vocabulary and short phrases through reading.
content_standards.3.2: Use appropriate sentence writing and punctuation.
content_standards.3.3: Communicate ideas creatively through suitable media and language.

learning_standards.1.1.1: Listen and give an appropriate response to a stimulus.
learning_standards.1.1.2: Show understanding of short spoken instructions.
learning_standards.1.2.1: Hear and pronounce vocabulary and short phrases.
learning_standards.1.2.2(i): Listen to and sing nursery rhymes.
learning_standards.1.3.1: Respond to everyday conversation with support.
learning_standards.1.3.2(i): Join supported exchanges using basic greetings.
learning_standards.1.3.2(iii): Follow basic classroom directions with support during an exchange.
learning_standards.1.4.1(i): Demonstrate listening comprehension using yes/no responses.
learning_standards.1.4.1(ii): Demonstrate listening comprehension by judging statements true or false.
learning_standards.1.4.1(iii): Demonstrate listening comprehension by answering Wh-questions.
learning_standards.2.1.3: Read and show comprehension of vocabulary and short phrases.
learning_standards.3.1.1: Copy and write familiar sight vocabulary legibly.
learning_standards.3.2.1(i): Use lowercase letters correctly in sentences.
learning_standards.3.2.1(ii): Use uppercase letters correctly in sentences.
learning_standards.3.2.1(iv): Use full stops correctly in sentences.

lessons.title: Months and events
lessons.objective: Pronounce six month names and answer three spoken questions about planned events.
lessons.success_criterion: Pronounce six month names and answer three spoken questions about planned events.
lessons.materials: Textbook p. 43–44; Calendar cards, event pictures
lessons.guided: Introduce six month names using the textbook class planner; model their pronunciation and ask about three events.
lessons.practice: Pupils pronounce the six selected months, then listen to three event questions and locate the matching months on the planner.
lessons.support: Use numbered month slots and a reduced card set
lessons.closure: Name the month following a selected card
lessons.assessment: Record six pronunciation attempts and three responses separately.
lessons.reflection_criterion: Pronounce six month names and answer three spoken questions about planned events.
lessons.standard_audit: Textbook teacher-note codes on pages 43–66 and DSKP extracted text reviewed 2026-11-26; fresh PDF page screenshots unavailable. Activities independently adapted.

lessons.title: Calendar dialogue
lessons.objective: Read and match three of four calendar questions and answers.
lessons.success_criterion: Read and match three of four calendar questions and answers.
lessons.materials: Textbook p. 45; Fictional class planner, dialogue strips
lessons.guided: Model reading a question and locating the matching event in the class planner.
lessons.practice: Pairs read four short calendar exchanges using different event cards and match each answer to its month.
lessons.support: Mark the event row and provide two answer choices
lessons.closure: Read one question with a partner
lessons.reflection_criterion: Read and match three of four calendar questions and answers.
lessons.standard_audit: Textbook teacher-note codes on pages 43–66 and DSKP extracted text reviewed 2026-11-26; fresh PDF page screenshots unavailable. Activities independently adapted.

lessons.title: Writing month names
lessons.objective: Find four of six events in the planner and copy their month names legibly.
lessons.success_criterion: Find four of six events in the planner and copy their month names legibly.
lessons.materials: Textbook p. 46–47; Calendar, word bank, writing sheets
lessons.guided: Model copying a month name from the planner
lessons.practice: Pupils read six original event clues, locate the corresponding month in the planner and copy its name, using letter prompts if necessary.
lessons.support: Provide first-letter prompts and enlarged text
lessons.closure: Compare one answer with the planner
lessons.assessment: Check correct month selection and legibility.
lessons.reflection_criterion: Find four of six events in the planner and copy their month names legibly.
lessons.standard_audit: Textbook teacher-note codes on pages 43–66 and DSKP extracted text reviewed 2026-11-26; fresh PDF page screenshots unavailable. Activities independently adapted.

lessons.title: Celebration card display
lessons.objective: Make a greeting card with a readable month and greeting.
lessons.success_criterion: Make a greeting card with a readable month and greeting.
lessons.materials: Textbook p. 48; Folded cards, stickers, month bank
lessons.guided: Model folding a card, choosing a month and writing a simple birthday greeting.
lessons.practice: Pupils make a card for a fictional friend, add the month and a greeting and decorate it with paper shapes.
lessons.support: Provide adhesive labels and precut decoration
lessons.closure: Read the month on the card
lessons.assessment: Check that the card has a greeting and readable month label.
lessons.reflection_criterion: Make a greeting card with a readable month and greeting.
lessons.source_note: Textbook p.48 prints 3.3.1(ii); the greeting-card activity aligns with DSKP 3.3.1(i).
lessons.standard_audit: Textbook teacher-note codes on pages 43–66 and DSKP extracted text reviewed 2026-11-26; fresh PDF page screenshots unavailable. Activities independently adapted.

lessons.title: Occupation song cues
lessons.objective: Sing at three occupation-word cues in the song.
lessons.success_criterion: Sing at three occupation-word cues in the song.
lessons.induction: Show a picture of a baker
lessons.guided: Use three worker pictures and model singing the occupation words to the textbook tune.
lessons.practice: Pupils choose a worker card, sing the target word at three cues, and match a worker to a workplace after singing.
lessons.support: Use a spoken rhythmic version or communication board
lessons.closure: Match one worker to a workplace
lessons.assessment: Record vocal participation at three cues; record non-vocal adaptations separately.
lessons.reflection_criterion: Sing at three occupation-word cues in the song.
lessons.standard_audit: Textbook teacher-note codes on pages 43–66 and DSKP extracted text reviewed 2026-11-26; fresh PDF page screenshots unavailable. Activities independently adapted.
lessons.source_note: Textbook p.49 prints 1.2.2(i); the named song fits DSKP song subcode 1.2.2(ii).

lessons.title: Reading job clues
lessons.objective: Read and match four of five short job clues to workers.
lessons.success_criterion: Read and match four of five short job clues to workers.
lessons.materials: Textbook p. 50–51; Worker pictures, original clue cards
lessons.induction: Show a picture of a pilot
lessons.guided: Model reading a short work-action phrase and matching it to a worker picture.
lessons.practice: Pupils read five original clues about familiar jobs and match each clue to a picture of the worker.
lessons.support: Use one highlighted verb per clue
lessons.closure: Read a clue to a partner
lessons.reflection_criterion: Read and match four of five short job clues to workers.
lessons.standard_audit: Textbook teacher-note codes on pages 43–66 and DSKP extracted text reviewed 2026-11-26; fresh PDF page screenshots unavailable. Activities independently adapted.

lessons.title: Occupation story reading
lessons.objective: Read and match three of four short phrases to events in the police story.
lessons.success_criterion: Read and match three of four short phrases to events in the police story.
lessons.guided: Read the textbook story with picture support and model matching one phrase to a story scene.
lessons.practice: Pupils read four short original phrases about the story and place each by a scene; discuss seeking a trusted adult if danger is seen.
lessons.support: Use picture choices; reinforce seeking help from a trusted adult
lessons.closure: Name the worker in the story
lessons.reflection_criterion: Read and match three of four short phrases to events in the police story.
lessons.standard_audit: Textbook teacher-note codes on pages 43–66 and DSKP extracted text reviewed 2026-11-26; fresh PDF page screenshots unavailable. Activities independently adapted.

lessons.title: Worker and action sentences
lessons.objective: Write four of five missing job-action words legibly with correct spelling.
lessons.success_criterion: Write four of five missing job-action words legibly with correct spelling.
lessons.materials: Textbook p. 53; Word tiles, substitution grid
lessons.guided: Model choosing an action word from a worker-action grid and writing it into a short sentence.
lessons.practice: Pupils match five workers to actions, then write the missing action words into original sentence frames.
lessons.support: Provide two action options per worker
lessons.assessment: Check word choice, spelling and legibility.
lessons.reflection_criterion: Write four of five missing job-action words legibly with correct spelling.
lessons.standard_audit: Textbook teacher-note codes on pages 43–66 and DSKP extracted text reviewed 2026-11-26; fresh PDF page screenshots unavailable. Activities independently adapted.

lessons.title: Job picture booklet
lessons.objective: Create three labelled worker-picture collages in a booklet.
lessons.success_criterion: Create three labelled worker-picture collages in a booklet.
lessons.materials: Textbook p. 54; Folded paper, job images, glue
lessons.guided: Model attaching a worker picture and a separate tool or workplace cut-out to a booklet page, then add a label.
lessons.practice: Pupils assemble three collage pages with worker pictures and appropriate details; label the workers using a word bank.
lessons.support: Use adhesive word tiles or tracing guides
lessons.assessment: Check three readable labels and the attached collage details.
lessons.reflection_criterion: Create three labelled worker-picture collages in a booklet.
lessons.source_note: Adaptation adds a collage element to meet DSKP 3.3.1(ii); original textbook craft retained.
lessons.standard_audit: Textbook teacher-note codes on pages 43–66 and DSKP extracted text reviewed 2026-11-26; fresh PDF page screenshots unavailable. Activities independently adapted.

lessons.title: Bus song participation
lessons.objective: Sing along at three target cues in the bus song.
lessons.success_criterion: Sing along at three target cues in the bus song.
lessons.materials: Textbook p. 55; Bus model, gesture cards
lessons.guided: Model singing with picture cues and optional seated movements.
lessons.practice: Pupils choose bus-related pictures and sing the target words at three cues; no physical movement is required.
lessons.support: Allow pointing instead of movement and offer quiet pacing
lessons.assessment: Record vocal responses to three cues and adapted responses separately.
lessons.reflection_criterion: Sing along at three target cues in the bus song.
lessons.standard_audit: Textbook teacher-note codes on pages 43–66 and DSKP extracted text reviewed 2026-11-26; fresh PDF page screenshots unavailable. Activities independently adapted.

lessons.title: Transport questions
lessons.objective: Answer five of seven oral questions about transport and state or select a travel preference.
lessons.success_criterion: Answer five of seven oral questions about transport and state or select a travel preference.
lessons.materials: Textbook p. 56–57; Vehicle pictures, three sorting mats
lessons.induction: Show a boat and a car
lessons.guided: Use pictures of vehicles to model questions about transport and where it travels.
lessons.practice: Ask seven Wh-questions aloud. Pupils answer by speaking or selecting picture cards; include a preference question with a reason choice.
lessons.support: Use two choices and a sentence starter
lessons.assessment: Count relevant responses and note prompts.
lessons.reflection_criterion: Answer five of seven oral questions about transport and state or select a travel preference.
lessons.standard_audit: Textbook teacher-note codes on pages 43–66 and DSKP extracted text reviewed 2026-11-26; fresh PDF page screenshots unavailable. Activities independently adapted.

lessons.title: School transport sentences
lessons.objective: Read and match four short transport phrases to pictures.
lessons.success_criterion: Read and match four short transport phrases to pictures.
lessons.materials: Textbook p. 58; Original sentence cards, vehicle pictures
lessons.guided: Model reading a vehicle name and short travel phrase.
lessons.practice: Pupils read four original travel phrases, match each to a vehicle picture and use one in a fictional school journey.
lessons.support: Highlight the vehicle word; provide a communication board
lessons.closure: Read a sentence to a partner
lessons.reflection_criterion: Read and match four short transport phrases to pictures.
lessons.standard_audit: Textbook teacher-note codes on pages 43–66 and DSKP extracted text reviewed 2026-11-26; fresh PDF page screenshots unavailable. Activities independently adapted.

lessons.title: Reading a travel list
lessons.objective: Read a short travel list and identify three listed vehicles.
lessons.success_criterion: Read a short travel list and identify three listed vehicles.
lessons.materials: Textbook p. 59; Textbook, simple fictional map, vehicle tokens
lessons.induction: Show a picture of an island
lessons.guided: Model locating vehicle words in a short travel passage and explain how commas separate the items.
lessons.practice: Pupils read an original three-item travel list, match the vehicles to picture tokens and point to the separators.
lessons.support: Use coloured separators and picture clues
lessons.assessment: Record three correct vehicle matches; comma recognition is enrichment only.
lessons.reflection_criterion: Read a short travel list and identify three listed vehicles.
lessons.standard_audit: Textbook teacher-note codes on pages 43–66 and DSKP extracted text reviewed 2026-11-26; fresh PDF page screenshots unavailable. Activities independently adapted.

lessons.title: Boat model display
lessons.objective: Make a labelled boat display with a model and at least two attached collage details.
lessons.success_criterion: Make a labelled boat display with a model and at least two attached collage details.
lessons.materials: Textbook p. 60; Cardboard boat base, paper sail, paper shapes, tape, blunt scissors; teacher-prepared parts
lessons.guided: Model attaching the sail to a stable paper base and arranging two travel-themed paper cut-outs on a display backing.
lessons.practice: Pupils assemble a dry tabletop boat model with support, attach two cut-outs to its backing and add a readable label.
lessons.support: Use precut pieces; no sharp plastic cutting or water trial is required.
lessons.assessment: Check model, collage details and label.
lessons.reflection_criterion: Make a labelled boat display with a model and at least two attached collage details.
lessons.source_note: Adaptation adds a collage element to meet DSKP 3.3.1(ii); original textbook craft retained.
lessons.standard_audit: Textbook teacher-note codes on pages 43–66 and DSKP extracted text reviewed 2026-11-26; fresh PDF page screenshots unavailable. Activities independently adapted.

lessons.title: Counting monkey song
lessons.objective: Sing at three number-word cues in the monkey song.
lessons.success_criterion: Sing at three number-word cues in the monkey song.
lessons.materials: Textbook p. 61; Monkey pictures, number cards
lessons.guided: Use five monkey picture cards and model the song, changing the number card as the count decreases.
lessons.practice: Pupils select the next number card and sing the target number words at three cues.
lessons.support: Use tabletop cards instead of physical movement
lessons.assessment: Record three vocal cues and any adapted responses separately.
lessons.reflection_criterion: Sing at three number-word cues in the monkey song.
lessons.standard_audit: Textbook teacher-note codes on pages 43–66 and DSKP extracted text reviewed 2026-11-26; fresh PDF page screenshots unavailable. Activities independently adapted.

lessons.title: Zoo animal picture talk
lessons.objective: Answer five of seven spoken animal questions, including one yes/no and Wh-questions.
lessons.success_criterion: Answer five of seven spoken animal questions, including one yes/no and Wh-questions.
lessons.materials: Textbook p. 62–63; Animal pictures, toy figures
lessons.guided: Model asking about a zoo picture and choosing an animal name or feature.
lessons.practice: Ask seven questions aloud using animal pictures, including a yes/no question and Wh-questions; pupils respond using speech or picture choices.
lessons.support: Provide two animal choices and tactile figures
lessons.assessment: Count relevant responses and record prompt level.
lessons.reflection_criterion: Answer five of seven spoken animal questions, including one yes/no and Wh-questions.
lessons.standard_audit: Textbook teacher-note codes on pages 43–66 and DSKP extracted text reviewed 2026-11-26; fresh PDF page screenshots unavailable. Activities independently adapted.

lessons.title: Reading animal features
lessons.objective: Read and match four of five animal-feature phrases to pictures.
lessons.success_criterion: Read and match four of five animal-feature phrases to pictures.
lessons.materials: Textbook p. 64; Feature strips, animal pictures
lessons.guided: Model reading a short animal-feature phrase and selecting the matching animal.
lessons.practice: Pupils read five original feature clues and match them to animal pictures.
lessons.support: Highlight the key feature word and use picture cues
lessons.reflection_criterion: Read and match four of five animal-feature phrases to pictures.
lessons.standard_audit: Textbook teacher-note codes on pages 43–66 and DSKP extracted text reviewed 2026-11-26; fresh PDF page screenshots unavailable. Activities independently adapted.

lessons.title: Favourite animal dialogue
lessons.objective: Read three short dialogue lines and answer one spoken Wh-question about a favourite animal.
lessons.success_criterion: Read three short dialogue lines and answer one spoken Wh-question about a favourite animal.
lessons.materials: Textbook p. 65; Dialogue cards, animal pictures
lessons.guided: Model reading a short exchange and ask why a character prefers an animal.
lessons.practice: Pairs read three short dialogue lines and answer a teacher's spoken Wh-question using a feature picture or words.
lessons.support: Supply a sentence frame or speech output
lessons.closure: Show an animal and state one feature
lessons.assessment: Record reading participation and listening response separately.
lessons.reflection_criterion: Read three short dialogue lines and answer one spoken Wh-question about a favourite animal.
lessons.standard_audit: Textbook teacher-note codes on pages 43–66 and DSKP extracted text reviewed 2026-11-26; fresh PDF page screenshots unavailable. Activities independently adapted.

lessons.title: Animal scene display
lessons.objective: Make a labelled animal diorama with three animal pictures and two attached habitat details.
lessons.success_criterion: Make a labelled animal diorama with three animal pictures and two attached habitat details.
lessons.materials: Textbook p. 66; Shoebox, precut animals, label cards
lessons.guided: Model arranging animal cut-outs and paper habitat elements inside a shallow box, then attach labels.
lessons.practice: Pupils attach three animal pictures and two habitat details to the backing, assemble the display and add three readable labels.
lessons.support: Provide preassembled display base and large printed words
lessons.assessment: Check the attached collage elements and three correct labels.
lessons.reflection_criterion: Make a labelled animal diorama with three animal pictures and two attached habitat details.
lessons.source_note: Adaptation adds a collage element to meet DSKP 3.3.1(ii); original textbook craft retained.
